mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_ai_task WHERE biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND status = 'PENDING' AND (next_dispatch_at IS NULL OR next_dispatch_at <= NOW(6)) ORDER BY next_dispatch_at, id LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET next_dispatch_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, LEAST(300, 30 * POW(2, LEAST(COALESCE(dispatch_attempts, 0), 4))), NOW(6)), dispatch_attempts = LEAST(COALESCE(dispatch_attempts, 0) + 1, 2147483647), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND status = 'PENDING' AND (next_dispatch_at IS NULL OR next_dispatch_at <= NOW(6))

UPDATE t_ai_task SET status = 'RUNNING', execution_token = #{token}, started_at = NOW(), next_dispatch_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 900, NOW(6)), finished_at = NULL, cost_time = NULL, result_payload = NULL, error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET generated_payload = #{payload}, next_dispatch_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 900, NOW(6)), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token = #{token} AND next_dispatch_at > NOW(6)

UPDATE t_ai_task SET status = #{task.status}, retry_count = #{task.retryCount}, result_payload = #{task.resultPayload}, error_message = #{task.errorMessage}, finished_at = #{task.finishedAt}, cost_time = #{task.costTime}, execution_token = NULL, next_dispatch_at = CASE WHEN #{task.status} = 'RETRYING' THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, LEAST(300, 30 * POW(2, LEAST(#{task.retryCount}, 4))), NOW(6)) ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{task.id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token = #{token}

UPDATE t_ai_task SET status = 'PENDING', execution_token = NULL, next_dispatch_at = NULL, dispatch_attempts = 0, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, cost_time = NULL, result_payload = NULL, error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND status IN ('RETRYING', 'FAILED') AND generated_payload IS NOT NULL AND generated_payload != '' AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) = #{retryCount} AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < COALESCE(max_retry_count, 3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_ai_task WHERE biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND (status = 'RUNNING' OR (status = 'RETRYING' AND generated_payload IS NOT NULL AND generated_payload != '' AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < COALESCE(max_retry_count, 3))) AND next_dispatch_at <= NOW(6) ORDER BY next_dispatch_at, id LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET status = CASE WHEN generated_payload IS NULL OR generated_payload = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1 >= COALESCE(max_retry_count, 3) THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RETRYING' END, error_message = '执行租约到期；无检查点需核查模型结果，有检查点按预算接续', next_dispatch_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, LEAST(300, 30 * POW(2, LEAST(COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1, 4))), NOW(6)), retry_count = COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1, execution_token = NULL, finished_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND next_dispatch_at <= NOW(6)

UPDATE t_ai_task SET status = 'PENDING', next_dispatch_at = NULL, dispatch_attempts = 0, execution_token = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND status = 'RETRYING' AND next_dispatch_at <= NOW(6) AND generated_payload IS NOT NULL AND generated_payload != '' AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < COALESCE(max_retry_count, 3)
mapper.select: SELECT status AS taskStatus, COUNT(*) AS taskCount, GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(create_time), NOW())) AS oldestSeconds FROM t_ai_task WHERE biz_type = 'ARTICLE' AND task_type = 'ARTICLE_SUMMARY_TAG_VECTOR' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRYING', 'UNKNOWN', 'FAILED') GROUP BY status
